blurb: Columbia Island Marina provides wet slips for motor boats 20-50 feet, transient dockage, and seasonal slips. Amenities include a full-service restaurant, catering, restrooms, fuel dock, and a ship store. Rentals include single kayaks by the hour, with guided tours and lessons available at nearby boathouses.
